in_marathi.name: Dvija
in_marathi.long_meaning: Dvija हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। One who has undergone the initiation ceremony (Upanayana) and is considered twice born. This name signifies a deep spiritual understanding and a strong connection to one's heritage.
